drugs.name: Tiotropium
drugs.efficacy: Reduces exacerbations and improves lung function and quality of life
drugs.adverse_effects: Dry mouth, urinary retention, cough, pharyngitis

drugs.name: Roflumilast
drugs.mechanism: Selective phosphodiesterase-4 (PDE4) inhibitor reducing airway inflammation
drugs.efficacy: Reduces moderate-to-severe exacerbations in severe chronic bronchitis COPD
drugs.adverse_effects: Diarrhea, weight loss, nausea, insomnia, depression

drugs.name: Indacaterol
drugs.mechanism: Ultra-long-acting beta-2 adrenergic receptor agonist (LABA) bronchodilator

drugs.name: Fluticasone / Salmeterol
drugs.efficacy: Reduces exacerbation rate in patients with frequent exacerbations or high eosinophils
drugs.adverse_effects: Oral candidiasis, dysphonia, increased risk of pneumonia

drugs.name: Dupilumab
drugs.mechanism: IL-4Ralpha antagonist blocking dual IL-4 and IL-13 signaling
drugs.efficacy: Reduces exacerbations and improves FEV1 in COPD with type 2 inflammation
